findings.scenario: Open the real BI route, select another view/period and specific base/candidate/currency or result, render it, open one authorized origin, then navigate Back.
findings.observed_source: Extended BI initializes state only from initial location URL; control changes/load do not update URL or history.state. Source anchors navigate in the same tab. pagehide clears the workspace and persisted pageshow forces reload. restoreBiFocus is not imported/called. Therefore the return path reconstructs the initial selection, losing the subsequent human selection and row focus.
findings.impact: The reviewer must reconstruct a comparison to continue; a return to the original initial view may be mistaken for the comparison just inspected.
findings.expected_correction: Preserve the exact authorized selection and focus through origin navigation/Back; reauthorize before render and clear retained identity on revocation. Never persist protected projection bytes or silently choose a substitute when a selection is stale.
findings.required_recheck: Hosted real-browser change filters/versions/currency -> explicit origin -> Back -> same choices and focus after current authorization; revoked/stale selection produces explicit unavailable and no stale private content.
findings.notified: Root received immediately and acknowledged correction planned for W9.

findings.owner: WP10; canonical destination producers if absent
findings.scenario: Read a persisted scenario/portfolio/sensitivity in BI09-BI11 and try to open its recorded result, component source, cost coverage, pending question or case.
findings.observed_source: Extended BI passes only four arguments to renderBiView. The fifth BiDecisionNavigation argument is absent. Producers gate openResult/openSource/openEvidence/openCoverage/openQuestion/openCase controls on these callbacks; without them they render identifiers as text. The supplied callback handles ProjectionValue drilldown only, using valueId/refDigest.
findings.impact: Decision BI presents evidence references without the expected path to inspect their original contextual artifacts; the producer API is present but not consumed.
findings.expected_correction: Compose only canonical authorized destinations for exact protected references, with source/case/ACL revalidation and no guessed destination based solely on a textual ID. Missing producer destinations must be explicit dependencies, not declared implemented.
findings.required_recheck: Hosted real BI decision -> each supported result/source/coverage/question/case target; ambiguous/foreign ref, revoked membership, changed source and late response must not supply destinations.
findings.notified: Root received immediately and acknowledged destination inspection/correction.

findings.scenario: Open an authorized preserved review or preparation workspace, keep focus outside a form, then click the canonical shell Refresh data or let its30-second poll complete.
findings.observed_source: Extended HTTP marks only BI with data-sf-retain-view. Review workspace has neither that marker nor a listener that claims sucafina:main-refresh. The shell replaces main with newly fetched HTML containing Loading review and calls only its own attach(); the review bundle/bootstrap remain outside main and are not re-executed. The mounted reader is therefore replaced by an uninitialized loading placeholder. In addition, extended-browser has no sf-access-revoked subscription to dispose/abort its retained object when the shell revokes.
findings.impact: The user loses the review/preparation consumer at ordinary authorized refresh. The disconnected reader also lacks coordinated shell-revocation teardown. This is a functional/lifecycle finding; no claim of a new server authorization leak.
findings.expected_correction: Keep or intentionally reinitialize the live review consumer across shell refresh while continuing current authority checks; coordinate deterministic abort/disposal on access loss and do not let held successes recreate removed private content.
findings.required_recheck: Hosted real shell+compiled review: manual and periodic refresh retain an operable review/preparation consumer; updates preserve original review, and actual session/case/source revocation disposes both connected and held views.
findings.notified: Root received immediately before report preparation.

positive_static_observations: BI call generation and AbortController handling prevent a superseded request from replacing a newer projection; clearPrivate removes selection/version options, links and projection and aborts pending reads.
BI source HTTP selection reopens the protected projection after destination resolution; explicit refDigest must belong to the current selected value, with no A/B array-order fallback.
BI lifecycle W8 test uses actual Chromium cookie/navigation, local-operator encrypted session revocation and real compiled shell/BI bundle. It does not assert installed native authority or AM proof.
Prepared-change UI binds reviewDigest, human checkbox and exact idempotency body/key; uncertain response locks the original request rather than creating a new application.
Scenario/AlternativeDraft presentation preserves subtotal versus total and unresolved coverage; proposal is visibly not applied.
README declares composition under review, material C07/C12/C17/native limits, real-producer requirement, and distinction between candidate checks and global acceptance.

No native UI walkthrough, actual user comprehension study or 320/768/1440px at 200% zoom on the reviewed W8 has been observed by this reviewer.
No 30 comparable performance repetitions or p95 baseline analysis; source optimizations and test timeouts are not performance qualification.

Existing Finance/Operations C12 CAS, no-op coverage proof and HotTopic source-domain findings prevent some preparation -> promotion -> application paths; retain their owner findings rather than reclassifying them as acceptable UX.
C17 source drift, mixed/nested historical calculation without authentic replay/capture, policy and project memory are not closed by W8.
All eight final selections, AM01-AM06, installed native authority/model/scanner/Relay evidence, three final-bundle independent acceptances and C/G7 then D/G8 remain mandatory.
